content: Root cause: The bug was caused by a compilation error due to the use of an incorrect constant, `BIOSAL_FALSE`, instead of the correct constant `CORE_FALSE` in two instances within the `pami_transport.c` file. This change was introduced in a previous commit (b49f6d85e6), leading to the failure in compiling the code. The patch corrects this by replacing `BIOSAL_FALSE` with `CORE_FALSE`, ensuring that the code compiles successfully.

Root cause:
The bug was caused by a compilation error due to the use of an incorrect constant, `BIOSAL_FALSE`, instead of the correct constant `CORE_FALSE` in two instances within the `pami_transport.c` file. This change was introduced in a previous commit (b49f6d85e6), leading to the failure in compiling the code. The patch corrects this by replacing `BIOSAL_FALSE` with `CORE_FALSE`, ensuring that the code compiles successfully.
Patch:
From f82e7872289761319dd98a6527ef3310c1c75bd5 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?S=C3=A9bastien=20Boisvert?= <boisvert@anl.gov>
Date: Wed, 1 Oct 2014 01:39:35 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] transport: fix pami compilation error introduced in
 b49f6d85e6
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

Link: https://github.com/GeneAssembly/biosal/issues/709
Signed-off-by: Sébastien Boisvert <boisvert@anl.gov>
---
 engine/thorium/transport/pami/pami_transport.c | 4 ++--
 1 file changed, 2 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/engine/thorium/transport/pami/pami_transport.c b/engine/thorium/transport/pami/pami_transport.c
index b6a1abb2..4a4c7e78 100644
--- a/engine/thorium/transport/pami/pami_transport.c
+++ b/engine/thorium/transport/pami/pami_transport.c
@@ -182,7 +182,7 @@ int thorium_pami_transport_send(struct thorium_transport *self, struct thorium_m
     pami_transport = thorium_transport_get_concrete_transport(self);
 
     thorium_send_cookie_t *send_cookie;
-    if (core_fast_queue_dequeue(pami_transport->avail_send_cookies_queue, &send_cookie) == BIOSAL_FALSE) {
+    if (core_fast_queue_dequeue(pami_transport->avail_send_cookies_queue, &send_cookie) == CORE_FALSE) {
 	send_cookie = (thorium_send_cookie_t *)malloc(sizeof(thorium_send_cookie_t));
 	CORE_DEBUGGER_ASSERT(send_cookie != NULL);
     }
@@ -296,7 +296,7 @@ void thorium_recv_message_fn(pami_context_t context, void *cookie, const void *h
     struct thorium_pami_transport *pami_transport = (struct thorium_pami_transport *) cookie;
     thorium_recv_cookie_t *recv_cookie;
 
-    if (core_fast_queue_dequeue(pami_transport->avail_recv_cookies_queue, (void *)&recv_cookie) == BIOSAL_FALSE) {
+    if (core_fast_queue_dequeue(pami_transport->avail_recv_cookies_queue, (void *)&recv_cookie) == CORE_FALSE) {
 	recv_cookie = (thorium_recv_cookie_t *)malloc(sizeof(thorium_recv_cookie_t));
 	CORE_DEBUGGER_ASSERT(recv_cookie != NULL);
     }
